meta.description: Persisty's symbol, colours and files, ready to download.

title: Persisty brand
body: The symbol, the colours and the files for anyone writing about, presenting or building an integration with Persisty.

symbol.title: The symbol
symbol.body: A "p" whose bowl is an open orbit, with a dot travelling it: the agent that keeps working while you are away. On the site, the dot goes round once every 14 seconds.

colors.title: Colours
colors.limeHint: The brand colour: the dot, buttons and links. Text on lime is always dark.
colors.limeLightHint: Only on light backgrounds, where lime disappears.
colors.paperHint: The "p" and the name on dark backgrounds.
colors.inkHint: Page background and the "p" on light backgrounds.
colors.graphiteHint: The app icon and the app's windows.

rules.title: How to use it
items: Write Persisty with a capital P in text; the logo is always lowercase.
Leave clear space around the logo of at least half the symbol's height.
Minimum size: symbol 16 px, logo 96 px wide.

donts.title: Don't
items: Change the colour of the dot or the "p".
Use lime on a light background.
Rotate, stretch or outline the symbol.
Close the orbit: the opening around the dot is part of the drawing.
